auftrag: Read the menu and the note. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: Today only: a free biscuit with every tea
The locker is at the back of the café, next to the toilets.
First: the price of the cheapest drink.
Second: the price of the carrot cake.
Third: the price of the toastie minus the price of a tea.
Last night somebody left a small parcel in the locker and asked me to keep it safe.
The person was in a big hurry and did not give a name, but I noticed that he kept looking over his shoulder.
He wore gloves, although it was warm, and he asked me not to tell anybody about the locker.
If a friend from London comes, give them this note.

raetsel.frage: What is the code for the locker?
raetsel.hilfe1: Find the cheapest drink first. Then the cake. For the third number you must subtract.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “The man gave Sam his name.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the second paragraph of the note.
raetsel.hilfe2: Sam says: ... did not give a name.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that shows the man did not want to be seen.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look for the words "over his shoulder".
raetsel.hilfe2: It is in the second paragraph, the second sentence.

raetsel.frage: Why does the man wear gloves although it is warm?
optionen: He does not want to leave fingerprints.
raetsel.hilfe1: Think about a person who hides something. What must a thief not leave behind?
raetsel.hilfe2: Fingerprints are a kind of proof.

raetsel.frage: Read the short text about Sam. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: Every morning Sam ___ the café at seven. He ___ tea and ___ the cakes. Last night a man ___ a parcel in the locker, and Sam ___ him not to tell anybody.
raetsel.hilfe1: Some actions happen every day. Some happened last night.
raetsel.hilfe2: Last night = the action is finished. The verb changes.
